title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PAYMENT OF EXTRA COMPENSATION TO MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE SCOUTS AND THE CONSTABULARY DETAILED FOR SPECIAL DUTY IN CONNECTION WITH THE ERECTION OF BAMBOO AND NIPA BUILDINGS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES, AT THE LOUISIANA PURCHASE EXPOSITION AT SAINT LOUIS, MISSOURI.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PAYMENT OF EXTRA COMPENSATION TO MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE SCOUTS AND THE CONSTABULARY DETAILED FOR SPECIAL DUTY IN CONNECTION WITH THE ERECTION OF BAMBOO AND NIPA BUILDINGS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES, AT THE LOUISIANA PURCHASE EXPOSITION AT SAINT LOUIS, MISSOURI.

title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้จ่ายค่าตอบแทนพิเศษแก่สมาชิกหน่วยลาดตระเวนฟิลิปปินส์และหน่วยตำรวจพลเรือนที่ได้รับมอบหมายปฏิบัติหน้าที่พิเศษเกี่ยวกับการก่อสร้างอาคารไม้ไผ่และใบตาลนิปาที่งานนิทรรศการซื้อขายลุยเซียนาที่เซนต์หลุยส์รัฐมิสซูรี
title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengizinkan pembayaran kompensasi tambahan kepada anggota Pasukan Pengintai Filipina dan Kepolisian yang ditugaskan untuk tugas khusus terkait pembangunan bangunan bambu dan daun nipah di Pameran Pembelian Louisiana di Saint Louis, Missouri
title.ms: Akta yang memberi kuasa bayaran kompensasi tambahan kepada ahli-ahli Askar Pengintai Filipina dan Pasukan Polis yang ditugaskan menjalankan tugas istimewa berkaitan pembinaan bangunan buluh dan nipah di Pameran Pembelian Louisiana di Saint Louis, Missouri

text.en:
The payment of a per diem allowance of fifty cents, United States currency, in addition to regular
compensation, to members of the Philippine Scouts and the Constabulary detailed at the request of the
Chairman of the Exposition Board for special duty in connection with the erection of bamboo and nipa
buildings and for other purposes, at the Louisiana Purchase Exposition at Saint Louis, Missouri, is hereby
authorized, the same to be paid out of appropriations made for the Saint Louis Imposition Board, the
provisions of Act Numbered One hundred and forty-eight to the contrary notwithstanding.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 3, 1904.
